title: Sloganeering against government not sedition: P&H High Court upholds acquittal in Dera Sacha Sauda violence case
description: Sloganeering against the government cannot lead to charges of sedition against citizens, the Punjab and Haryana High Court recently observed.A Bench of Justice Vinod S Bhardwaj and Justice Sukhvinder Kaur added that a violent protest may amount to rioting but such action of violence cannot be perceived as an act of bringing in hatred or contempt against the government.“A sloganeering against the Government or wings of governance, in an elected democracy, would not be sufficient to slap charges o
